# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 38 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens; Shadow — 1 token; Size — 6 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #ffffff);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #ffffff | Page ground in apps, report pages and templates. Plate behind every logo on a colour. |
| `--surface-soft` | #f2f5f9 | App page background behind cards, zebra rows in tables, the findings box. |
| `--surface-band` | #e3e3e3 | Report side band (fades from surface), empty track of a progress bar, table header fill in annexes. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 44px/48px "Ubuntu", "Trebuchet MS", system-ui, sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-cover-title);
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `fonts/Ubuntu-Medium.woff2`, `fonts/Ubuntu-Bold.woff2`, `fonts/OpenSans-Light.woff2`, `fonts/OpenSans-Regular.woff2`, `fonts/OpenSans-Italic.woff2`, `fonts/OpenSans-SemiBold.woff2`, `fonts/OpenSans-SemiBoldItalic.woff2` and `fonts/OpenSans-Bold.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/Ubuntu-Medium.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/Ubuntu-Medium.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system; the copy of `tokens.css` that each artboard links loads them from there. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ubuntu | `fonts/Ubuntu-Medium.woff2` (weight 500) | `read fonts/Ubuntu-Medium.woff2` | `var(--font-display)` | `ubuntu` |
| Open Sans | `fonts/OpenSans-Regular.woff2` (weight 400) | `read fonts/OpenSans-Regular.woff2` | `var(--font-text)` | `open-sans` |

Every face: `fonts/Ubuntu-Medium.woff2` (Ubuntu, 500), `fonts/Ubuntu-Bold.woff2` (Ubuntu, 700), `fonts/OpenSans-Light.woff2` (Open Sans, 300), `fonts/OpenSans-Regular.woff2` (Open Sans, 400), `fonts/OpenSans-Italic.woff2` (Open Sans, 400, italic), `fonts/OpenSans-SemiBold.woff2` (Open Sans, 600), `fonts/OpenSans-SemiBoldItalic.woff2` (Open Sans, 600, italic), `fonts/OpenSans-Bold.woff2` (Open Sans, 700).

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Gap between an icon and its label. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gap inside controls, between a tag and text. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Row padding in lists and tables. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Card and screen padding on phones. Gap between fields. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Gap between cards and between blocks of a report page. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Padding of result blocks and boxes in reports. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Gap between sections of a report page. Page margin of templates. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Inner margin of covers and openers. |
